comments.text: L3a carries texture.rs's procedural half (TextureFilter, TextureWrap, TextureData.Solid and Checker, ToSrgbByte) and the sRGB test. PNG loading and encoding and the glTF loader come in their own PR, L3b, because both read C arrays through raw pointers, which Nox can't index yet.

L3b: PNG loading through stb_image and a PNG encoder in Nox (stored deflate, so files are bigger than the png crate's but decode the same), and the glTF loader over cgltf. One difference from Rust: cgltf reads base64 data: URIs, which the Rust loader refused. Raw C arrays are read through typed views made with memmove(pointer, pointer, 0), the interim for the Nox card on indexing raw pointers.
